creatives.hook_concept: Question Hook — Who Are You Really?
creatives.hold_reason: HARD RULE FAIL — 2 auto-rejects: (1) Hard Rule 3: Opens on man standing holding Thinkle box to camera = static wide shot + talking head intro. Must open on genuine human emotion or action. (2) Hard Rule 1: 3 filming locations (grey apartment 1s / open-plan kitchen couch 8s / avocado painting living room 18s). Max 2 allowed. Also: all text orange with dark outline — change to white with drop shadow. Duration fixed (22.7s) — good. Recommendation: move 18s man-laughing frame to 1s as hook, cut to 2 locations max, change text to white.
creatives.notes: Scored under new official Meta rubric (2026-09-01). Hard Rule 1 FAIL (3 locations) + Hard Rule 3 FAIL (static wide shot opener) = AUTO-REJECT. V2 structure: man holding Thinkle box to camera with WHO ARE YOUR FRIENDS... REALLY? (1s) → card fan on wooden table (3s) → mirror/kaleidoscope transition on card backs (5s) → open-plan kitchen couch scene with couple writing score sheets (8s) → score sheet close-up showing real name word + rhyme word columns (12s) → man in plaid shirt laughing with Find out who your friends really are CTA (18s, avocado painting room) → product end card name word/rapid word/picture word + thinkle.com.au (22s). End card clean. Duration fixed from 42.5s → 22.7s. Move 18s laugh frame to 1s to fix hook opener.

creatives.creator: Jenne
creatives.hold_reason: 3 required fixes: (1) END CARD CTA — 'BUY THIS AMAZING GAME NOW!!!' is hard-sell ad language that kills native feel; replace grandmother verandah scene with a standard product end card or keep gameplay footage only + 'thinkle.com.au' URL. The grandmother scene also creates a jarring scene cohesion break (−15 pts). (2) Text style — all text is orange with dark outline; change to white with drop shadow (−15 pts). (3) Hook text too long — 'What's the game that makes the quietest person in the room the loudest?' = 13 words, over 8-word max; shorten to ≤8 words e.g. 'What makes the quiet ones the loudest?' (−10 pts). Note: typo FIXED (quietest ✓), duration FIXED (22.8s ✓) — good progress on V1 issues.
creatives.notes: Scored under new official Meta rubric (2026-09-01): 100 − 15 (orange text) − 10 (text length 13 words) − 10 (text in top third) − 15 (scene cohesion: grandmother verandah CTA disconnected from gameplay footage) = 50 → REJECT. V2 improvements: typo corrected ('quietest' ✓), duration cut from 31.1s → 22.8s ✓. Hard rules all PASS (1 filming location — avocado painting living room — plus verandah end card = 2 locations ✓; sharp opener ✓; human action hook ✓; text present ✓; no pricing ✓). Hook is strong (man arms raised, genuine celebration) and gameplay footage is excellent. The ONLY blockers are the grandmother CTA scene + text style. Fix those and this is 85+.
